pr_title: Group font options in the json into a single object
pr_body:
<!-- Enter a brief description/summary of your PR here. What does it fix/what does it change/how was it tested (even manually, if necessary)? -->
## Summary of the Pull Request
Introduces `FontConfig`, an object that isolates font-related settings in our profiles

Users can now define font settings in their json as so:
```
"font":{
    "face": "Consolas",
    "size": 12
}
```

Backwards compatible with the currently expected way of defining font settings in the json, note however that upon hitting 'Save' in the SUI, these settings **will be rewritten to the font-object style in the json (as above)**. 

<!-- Other than the issue solved, is this relevant to any other issues/existing PRs? -->

review_comments: nit: you don't actually need `if` here, right? `_FontInfo` can't be `nullptr`
It's there for consistency with the `_DefaultAppearance` check above (which technically also cannot be nullptr, but I feel like it's a 'just in case' kind of thing)
Actually if you call `get_self` on a nullptr your application will just straight up crash in almost all cases. 😅
If you do go with my pointer/reference suggestion you can get rid of this `winrt::com_ptr` "juggling". 😄
Same as above! I'd like to keep it this way to maintain consistency with how we do Profile copy and Appearance copy
I'd like to keep it this way for consistency with `DUPLICATE_SETTING_MACRO` and `DUPLICATE_APPEARANCE_SETTING_MACRO`!
